title: Fix role selection persisting incorrectly on role selection page

requirements.text: Fix the RoleSelectionPage so that it does not pre-populate or lock in a previously chosen role. When an authenticated user reaches the role selection screen, they must be presented with a fresh, unselected choice between Customer and Freelancer, and the previously stored role must not influence or pre-select the UI state.

quotes: Why role already choosen is coming when continuing as customer or freelancer

acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to the role selection page never shows a pre-selected or highlighted role from a previous session.
Both 'Customer' and 'Freelancer' options are rendered in an equal, unselected state when the page loads.
The user must actively click one of the roles before the confirm/continue action becomes enabled.
After selecting a role and confirming, the user is redirected to the correct dashboard.

If a user already has a role stored in the backend, they should be redirected away from the role selection page directly to their dashboard (not shown the role selection page with their old role pre-filled).

requirements.text: Fix the LoginPage redirect logic so that users who already have a role assigned in the backend are sent directly to their role-appropriate dashboard, bypassing the role selection page entirely. The role selection page should only be shown to users who have no role stored yet.

quotes: Why role already choosen is coming when continuing as customer or freelancer

acceptanceCriteria: A logged-in user with an existing 'customer' role is redirected to the customer dashboard, not the role selection page.
A logged-in user with an existing 'freelancer' role is redirected to the freelancer dashboard, not the role selection page.
Only users with no stored role profile are shown the role selection onboarding page.
No stale role state from localStorage, sessionStorage, or component state causes incorrect UI behavior on the role selection page.

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui.
All backend role storage logic must remain in backend/main.mo.
nonGoals: Allowing users to change their role after it has been set.
Adding new roles beyond Customer and Freelancer.
Modifying the backend role assignment or storage logic.
